    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_17/training_10.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_17/training_11.csv",
]

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    # index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column as per instructions
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION all source DataFrames (concatenate)
Target9_17 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the data types match the target schema exactly:
# Target schema:
# ['tripduration': int, 'starttime': str, 'stoptime': str,
#  'start station id': int, 'start station name': str,
#  'start station latitude': float, 'start station longitude': float,
#  'end station id': int, 'end station name': str,
#  'end station latitude': float, 'end station longitude': float,
#  'bikeid': int, 'usertype': str, 'birth year': int, 'gender': int]

# Convert columns to correct types explicitly
Target9_17['tripduration'] = Target9_17['tripduration'].astype(int)
Target9_17['starttime'] = Target9_17['starttime'].astype(str)
Target9_17['stoptime'] = Target9_17['stoptime'].astype(str)
Target9_17['start station id'] = Target9_17['start station id'].astype(int)
Target9_17['start station name'] = Target9_17['start station name'].astype(str)
Target9_17['start station latitude'] = Target9_17['start station latitude'].astype(float)
Target9_17['start station longitude'] = Target9_17['start station longitude'].astype(float)
Target9_17['end station id'] = Target9_17['end station id'].astype(int)
Target9_17['end station name'] = Target9_17['end station name'].astype(str)
Target9_17['end station latitude'] = Target9_17['end station latitude'].astype(float)
Target9_17['end station longitude'] = Target9_17['end station longitude'].astype(float)
Target9_17['bikeid'] = Target9_17['bikeid'].astype(int)
Target9_17['usertype'] = Target9_17['usertype'].astype(str)
Target9_17['birth year'] = Target9_17['birth year'].astype(int)
Target9_17['gender'] = Target9_17['gender'].astype(int)

# Write the final target table to the specified path
Target9_17.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_17/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
